name: ICWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: The ICWF Cruiserweight Championship changed hands at the Sixth Birthday Bash in September 2002, when Syd Barrett pinned a rival trio member to win a six-way Pyramid Match.

name: ICWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The ICWF Tag Team Championship changed hands at the Sixth Birthday Bash in September 2002, when the challenging Mob Squad, a three-man unit, won the titles from Brother & Brother in a Borneo Cage Match.
